name: Require an independent review before factory merges
description:
Factory review recommendation 1 of 20.

## Context

The In PR Stage Prompt permits merging on green CI without requiring an independent review.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add an explicit review gate before merge using a different worker/model from the implementer.
- Review the diff against the Story and record approval or actionable findings in a Comment.
- Return changes requiring fixes to implementation and prevent merge until approval and required checks pass.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: PLAN ACCEPTED with coordinated boundaries. Implement your independent-review section, implementation-record Comment before moves, brief slot and head-pinned approval. Record all known implementation attempts/models; unknown provenance asks rather than guesses. Post the same review as a GitHub PR comment (authorized as part of this Story). Leave branch protection unchanged. ROW-57 owns In PR step 2/check waiting; ROW-47 owns review/approval steps 3-4; ROW-48 owns return/failure step 5 and Returned work in In Progress. ROW-48 owns the shared rowbly-dev continuation wording; you own only adding draft-head SHA and answering review findings to handoff. Review may proceed while checks pending; merge waits for both, with --match-head-commit. Review return uses ROW-48 Returned to In Progress format plus numbered findings. Propose exact combined config outside .rowbly; do not apply it. No ADR required; proposed-prompt screenshot accepted. Merge latest main preserving other changes. Four checks required.
